description: Assembly source code for cryptographic hash functions and multiplication routines in BoringSSL's implementation of Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) using x86_64 architecture with AVX and CLMUL instructions.

methods.name: gcm_init_clmul
methods.description: Initializes GCM multiplication using CLMUL instructions.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_clmul
methods.description: Performs GCM multiplication using CLMUL instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_clmul
methods.description: Computes GCM GHASH using CLMUL instructions.

methods.name: gcm_init_avx
methods.description: Initializes GCM multiplication using AVX instructions.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_avx
methods.description: Performs GCM multiplication using AVX instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_avx
methods.description: Computes GCM GHASH using AVX instructions.
